spans.s:
n. (-र्म्म)
One's own act.
E.
आत्मन् and कर्म्म act.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Self-executed, done of one's self.
E.
आत्मन् and कृत done.

f. (-प्ता)
A plant, Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
E.
आत्मन् self, गुप्त hidden; self-preserved.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
Selfish, greedy, taking care of one's self, appropriating, taking for one's self.
E.
आत्मन् and ग्राहिन् who seizes.

Suicide.
2

Heresy, schism.
E.
आत्मन् and घात killing.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
1 A suicide.
2 A heretic, a schismatic, one who disregards the moral or religious institutions of the code.
E.
आत्मन् and घातिन् who kills.

m. (-षः)
1 A crow.
2 A cock.
E.
आत्मन्, घुषि to sound, and अण् aff.

m. (-जः)
A son.
f. (-जा)
1 A daughter.
2 The understanding.
E.
आत्मन् the body or soul, and ज born, produced.

m. (-न्मा)
A son.
E.
आत्मन् and जन्मन् birth.

m. (-ज्ञः)
A sage, one who knows his own nature and that of spirit. आत्मन् and ज्ञ who knows.

n. (-नं)
Spiritual knowledge, true wisdom.
E.
आत्मन् and ज्ञान knowledge.

ind. (-तं)
Apart, to one's self, (in theatrical language.)
E.
आत्मन् and गत gone.

n. (-त्वं)
The nature of spirit.
E.
आत्मन् and तत्व truth.

m. (-ज्ञः)
A sage, especially one versed in the Vedānta doctrines.
E.
आत्मतत्व and ज्ञ who knows.

f. (-ता)
1 Identity with self.
2 Spirituality.
E.
आत्मन् and तल् affix; also with त्व affix आत्मत्व.

m. (-गी)
1 A suicide.
2 A heretic, an unbeliever.
E.
आत्मन् and त्यागिन् who deserts.

m. (-र्शः)
A mirror.
E.
आत्मन् and दर्श sight, seeing.

n. (-नं)
Knowledge of man's real nature, spiritual knowledge.
E.
आत्मन् and दर्शन seeing.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
Self-tormenting, fretful, miserable.
E.
आत्मन् and द्रोहिन् who torments.

m. (-त्मा)
1 The soul.
2 The natural temperament or disposition.
3 BRAHM, the supreme deity and soul of the universe, or more usually in this sense परमात्मा.
4 Life, spirit, the vivifying soul in opposition to the sentient; commonly also जीवात्मा.
5

Body.
6

Care, effort, pains.
7

Firmness.
8

The understanding, the intellect.
9 The mind or faculty of reason.
10 The sun.
11

Fire.
12

Wind, air.
13 A son.
14 The self, the abstract individual.
E.
आङ्, अत to go, मनिन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Existent, sentient.
2 Appropriate, good for, fit for.
3 Suitable, (as diet, &c.)
m. (-नः)
1 A son.
2 A wife's brother.
3 A jester.
E.
आत्मन् and ख aff.

n. (-दं)
The middle voice, the proper form of the verb.
E.
आत्मने to one's self, पद inflected word.

m. (-न्धुः)
One's own kinsman, a first cousin or father's sister's son, mother's brother's son, mother's sister's son.
E.
आत्मन् own, and बन्धु relative.

f. (-द्धिः)
1 Self-knowledge.
2 One's own knowledge.
E.
आत्मन् and बुद्धि knowledge.

m. (-धः)
Spiritual instruction.
E.
आत्मन् and बोध causing to know.

m. (-वः)
Proper or peculiar nature.
E.
आत्मन् own, and भाव disposition.

mfn. (-भूः-भूः-भु)
Self-born, self-existent.
m. (-भूः)
1 A name of

BRAHMĀ.
2
Of

KĀMADEVA.
3
Of VIṢṆ

And of ŚIVA.
E.
आत्मन् self, and भू being.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Self-produced.
2 Own, peculiar, belonging to.
3 Attached to, faithful.
E.
आत्मन् and भूत become.

mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि)
Respecting one's self, decorous, respectable.
E.
आत्मन् and मानिन् respecting.

f. (-ली)
A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi): see दुरालभा.
E.
आत्मन् and मूल a root.

mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि)
Selfish, greedy.
E.
आत्मन् self, and भरि who nourishes, from भृ to nourish, with खि aff.

m. (-जी)
A wise or learned man, one who studies his own nature and that of the soul.
E.
आत्मन् and याजिन् who worships.

m. (-निः)
1 A name of

BRAHMĀ.
2
Of Ś

IVA.
3

Of VIṢṆU, and:
4 Of KĀMADEVA.
E.
आत्मन् self, and योनि the place of birth: see आत्मभू.

n. (-म)
1 The beard.
2 The hair of the body.
E.
आत्मन् and लोमन् hair.

ind.
Like one's self.
E.
आत्मन् and वति aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Prudent, considerate.
3 Selfpossessed, composed, calm.
E.
आत्मन् and मतुप् aff.

f. (-त्ता)
1 Self-resemblance.
2 Proportion, analogy.
3 Prudence, self-regard.
E.
तल् added to the preceding.

m. (-शः)
Subjection of the mind, self-controul, self-government.
E.
आत्मन् and वश subjection.

m. (-विद्)
1 A sensible man, one who knows himself.
2 A wise man, a sage, one who knows the nature of the soul or spirit.
E.
आत्मन् and विद् who knows.

f. (-द्या)
Spiritual knowledge.
E.
आत्मन् and विद्या science.

f. (-द्धिः)
Self-advantage.
E.
आत्मन् and विवृद्धि encrease.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Existent, sentient.
2 Appropriate, good for one's self.
3 Suitable, (as diet, &c.)
m. (-रः)
1 A wife's brother.
2 A jester.
E.
आत्मन् and बीर heroic, strong.

f. (-त्तिः)
Practising one's duties or occupation.
E.
आत्मन् and वृत्ति profession.

f. (-क्तिः)
Inherent or own power.
E.
आत्मन् self, and शक्ति power.

f. (-द्धिः)
Self-purification.
E.
आत्मन् and शुद्धि purity.

f. (-घा)
Boasting.
E.
आत्मन् self, and श्लाघा praise.

m. (-मः)
Self-restraint, stoicism.
E.
आत्मन् self, and संयम restraint.

m. (-हः)
Internal doubt.
E.
आत्मन् and सन्देह doubt.

m. (-वः)
A son.
E.
आत्मन् and सम्भव birth.

ind.
One's own.
E.
आत्मन् and सात् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Appropriated, made one's own.
E.
आत्मसात् and कृत made.

f. (-द्धिः)
Self-advantage.
E.
आत्मन् and सिद्धि accomplishment.

f. (-त्या)
Suicide, self-destruction.
E.
आत्मन् and हत्या killing.

m. (-हा)
1 A suicide, a self-murderer.
2 A heretic, an unbeliever.
3 A priest in a temple, a servant or attendant upon an idol.
E.
आत्मन् and हन् who kills or destroys, self-destroying; the priest subsisting by appropriating to himself offerings to deities, for which future punishment is assigned.

n. (-नं)
Suicide.
E.
आत्मन् and हनन killing.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Beneficial to one's self.
E.
आत्मन् and हित good for.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Self-counselled.
m. (-ष्टः)
A treaty dictated by the party wishing it himself.
E.
आत्मन् and आदिष्ट directed.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Sentient, existent.
m. (-नः)
1 A wife's brother.
2 A censorious man.
3 A son.
E.
आत्मन् and अधीन dependant.

m. (-कः)
An impostor, one who pretends to belong to a higher class than his own.
E.
आत्मन् and अपहारक a plunderer: who steals himself.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
For one's own sake, for the sake of one's self.
E.
आत्मन् and अर्थं object.

m. (-शी)
A fish.
E.
आत्मन्, अश to eat, णिनि affix; supposed to eat its young.

m. (-यः)
1 Self-dependance.
2 Innate idea, abstract knowledge, independant of the thing to be known.
E.
आत्मन् self, and आश्रय asylum.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Cognate, related, of kin.
2 Own.
E.
आत्मन् and छण् aff.

m. (-यः)
Self-advantage or elevation.
E.
आत्मन् and उदय rising.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Like one's self.
E.
आत्मन् and उपम resemblance.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
1 A public performer, actor, singer, dancer, &c.
2 A day labourer.
E.
आत्मन् self, उपजीविन् who subsists: who lives by his own exertions.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Born or produced from one's self.
m. (-वः)
A son.
f. (-वा)
1 A daughter.
2 A plant, (Glycine debilis.)
E.
आत्मन् and उद्भव born.
